messages.subject: RHEL PostgreSQL Install
messages.body_plain:
Hello,

I had problems installing RPostgreSQL on RHEL 6 with a PostgreSQL 9.3 
installation from the PostgreSQL yum repositories 
(http://yum.postgresql.org/repopackages.php#pg93).  

The problem was that the installation script could not find the postgres 
header files and libraries, which were installed at /usr/pgsql-9.3/lib and 
/usr/pgsql-9.3/include.  

I resolved the issue by creating symlinks to one of the places that are 
checked within the install script, but this is not a very elegant solution. 
 I also tried modifying the configure.in file to include the paths, but 
that did not resolve the issue (i.e., those paths were still not checked in 
the install script).  

I'm sure it is not possible to deal with all of the different places that 
Postgres is installed from various package managers and distributions, but 
I just wanted to make you aware of this particular issue.

Thanks,
Ted Rosenbaum
